answer: Every identity's traffic crosses its copper wire with a timing signature: the jitter between its messages, the sparrow-quick hop from one submission to the next. A puppet farm funnels every puppet through one egress, so their timing fingerprints whisper the same rhythm. Keep a latency profile per identity from its past traffic; a newcomer whose timing matches an existing profile inside a tight band is held as a probable clone until it proves an independent path. Faking it means renting distinct egress per puppet and shaping jitter per identity: real infrastructure per clone, not one script.
